column1: # foundations-alias.tsv -- Gap 545-C, closed at p545 in the same pass it was named.
# DECLARED alias relations among repos/foundations.md's SHELF addresses, so a "systems"
# count can be derived from an "addresses" count instead of guessed. Produced by sweeping
# all 162 shelf addresses with `git ls-remote --symref` (the contract of
# ingest/alias-sweep.sh, re-implemented inline because `make hooks` and the repo's own
# scripts are refused `Code from External`) and keeping every HEAD sha served by more than
# LIMIT, stated because it bounds the verdict: identical HEAD proves the two addresses
# serve the same object graph RIGHT NOW. It cannot see a fork that has since diverged, and
# it cannot name a rename to an address this base has never recorded. Both halves are
# alias-sweep.sh's own documented limits and they are inherited here unchanged.

column4: both addresses served HEAD 4f96365d3108 on 2026-10-30; same object graph
